name: nightpass
description: Privacy-preserving membership and access-control infrastructure for Midnight

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @nightpass/contract && npm run build --workspace @nightpass/client && npm run build --workspace @nightpass/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @nightpass/contract && npm run typecheck --workspace @nightpass/client && npm run typecheck --workspace @nightpass/web
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @nightpass/contract && npm run test --workspace @nightpass/client && npm run test --workspace @nightpass/web
scripts.verify: npm run compact && npm run typecheck && npm test
